q1_issues.issue: 'now' is dropped entirely — a deictic time is a speech-anchored constant that should be recorded, but no Time atom appears anywhere in the parse.

(ThanksTo sk_group_1 genetic_engineering) hangs a clause-level causal PP on the penguin group, but the connective form relates two reified eventualities and the sentence's causal claim is about the penguins' existence, not about the group as a positioned or originating entity.

q2_gaps: causal PP with an NP complement ('thanks to / because of / due to <NP>'): connective atoms require two reified eventualities, and the entity-attached surface-preposition licence is scoped to position and origin, so this construction has no licensed route
notes: The group witness plus distributing rule (rather than Inheritance on penguin) correctly avoids claiming penguins in general swim in lava, and Location on the swim event with bare 'lava' as a constant is right. (Inheritance genetic_engineering genetic) is borderline — 'genetic' is an adjective but a classifying one, outside the gradable/positional/material types the modifier-genus rule enumerates.
